_doc.zh: 说话用的视位（口形）表。方法取自 JALI（jali2016，已打开）：口形分解为 静止 + JA·（下颌 + 舌）+ LI·唇的动作单元；四条构音约束（双唇音必须闭唇；唇齿音下唇必须碰上齿；咝音下颌几乎合上；非鼻音发音时唇要张开过）；协同发音的习惯（重复的视位并成一个；lipHeavy 的视位提前开始、推迟结束，并取代邻居的唇形，邻居是双唇音 / 唇齿音时则同时发；tongueOnly 的视位不影响唇；很短的塞音 / 鼻音不影响下颌）；视位在音开始前 120 ms 起、结束后 120 ms 消退，唇前突的为 150 ms。音的分类（classes）取自它的附录 A。每个视位有两套下颌和唇的数值：jaw / aus 是正常朗读（风格 1，缺省），clear 是夸张 / 清晰发音（风格 2，即校准之前的那套数值，全部是假设）。正常朗读的下颌开度按电磁发音仪的实测均值标定（见 calibration 和每个视位的 provenance）；唇的 AU 强度仍是假设；舌的权重一部分取自实测的线圈高度，其余是假设。provenance 里每个数值要么写明出处，要么标 assumption。普通话的四个口形（YU、ZHCHSH、JQX、ER）和软腭擦音 HX 没有实测数据，全部是假设。音素记号是 ARPAbet 风格的，归并方式也是本项目定的。
_doc.en: The table of visemes (mouth shapes) for speech. Method from JALI (jali2016, opened): a mouth shape is rest + JA·(jaw + tongue) + LI·lip action units; four articulation constraints (bilabials must close the lips; labiodentals must touch the lower lip to the upper teeth; sibilants nearly close the jaw; non-nasals must open the lips at some point); co-articulation habits (duplicated visemes merge; lip-heavy visemes start early, end late and replace the lip shape of neighbours, or sound together with them when those are bilabial / labiodental; tongue-only visemes do not affect the lips; very short obstruents / nasals do not affect the jaw); a viseme starts 120 ms before its sound and decays over 120 ms after it, 150 ms for lip protrusion. The sound classes (`classes`) follow its appendix A. Each viseme has two sets of jaw and lip values: `jaw` / `aus` are normal read speech (style 1, the default) and `clear` is exaggerated / clear speech (style 2: the values the table had before calibration, all assumptions). The jaw openings of normal read speech are calibrated against measured means from electromagnetic articulography (see `calibration` and each viseme's `provenance`); the lip AU intensities remain assumptions; some tongue weights are taken from measured coil heights and the rest are assumptions. In `provenance` every number either names its source or is marked `assumption`. The four Mandarin shapes (YU, ZHCHSH, JQX, ER) and the velar fricative HX have no measurements behind them and are assumptions throughout. Phoneme symbols are ARPAbet-style and the grouping is this project's too.

nonCommercial.zh: MOCHA-TIMIT（fsew0、msak0）的许可只限研究、教育和个人使用；这里只用了本项目自己算的汇总量。
nonCommercial.en: MOCHA-TIMIT (fsew0, msak0) is licensed for research, educational and individual use only; only aggregates computed by this project are used here.

jaw.zh: 实测的 jawOpenMm 是下切牙线圈相对上切牙的竖直下降量（相对该说话人说话时的最高位置）。我们的下颌是绕颞下颌关节轴的转角：下切牙切缘在轴前方约 84 mm（男 83.7、女 84.3）、轴下方 46 / 37 mm，离轴 95.5 / 92.2 mm；小角度时切缘的竖直下降 ≈ 转角 × 84 mm，用骨架实算是每 1.0 的 jaw 比例（= 0.50615 rad = 29°）约 42.2 mm（比例 0.05–0.1 处，两副身体 42.0–42.4）。所以 jaw = 目标毫米数 / 42.2。目标 = 三位说话人各自均值的平均；例外：AA 取 aa、ay、aw 三个音素的均值（USC-TIMIT 的 ah 混有弱化元音，MOCHA 的 o 是圆唇的 [ɒ]），AX 只取 MOCHA 的 @（USC-TIMIT 没有单独的弱化元音标签）；SIL 不标定（语料里的停顿包含换气，口是开着的；这里的静止是闭口）。假设：把“说话时的最高位置”当作我们的闭口姿势（上下牙咬合，覆 1.2 mm），两者之间未知的差没有加进去。
jaw.en: The measured jawOpenMm is the vertical drop of the lower-incisor coil relative to the upper incisor (from the highest position that speaker reaches in speech). Our jaw is an angle about the temporomandibular axis: the lower incisal edge lies about 84 mm in front of the axis (male 83.7, female 84.3) and 46 / 37 mm below it, 95.5 / 92.2 mm away; for small angles its vertical drop ≈ angle × 84 mm, and computed with the rig it is about 42.2 mm per 1.0 of `jaw` fraction (= 0.50615 rad = 29°) at fractions 0.05–0.1 (42.0–42.4 over the two bodies). Hence jaw = target millimetres / 42.2. Target = the mean of the three speakers' means; exceptions: AA uses the phones aa, ay and aw (ah of USC-TIMIT is mixed with reduced vowels and MOCHA's o is the rounded [ɒ]), AX uses MOCHA's @ only (USC-TIMIT has no separate label for reduced vowels); SIL is not calibrated (pauses in the corpora include breaths with the mouth open; rest here is a closed mouth). Assumption: the highest position reached in speech is equated with our closed pose (teeth in occlusion, 1.2 mm of overbite); the unknown difference between the two is not added.

lips.zh: 唇的 AU 强度没有标定，仍是假设：线圈贴在唇红缘外，lipApertureMm 相对闭唇时的线圈距离，和唇内缘的间隙差一个未知的量（三位说话人之间相差一倍）；唇前伸只有 ±1.5 mm，只有次序可信。只做了几处由次序引出的调整（正常风格，仍是假设）：EH 的 AU25 3 → 4（实测唇开度最大的是 EH），IY 2.5 → 3，AA 3 → 2.5，L 2 → 1.5，TH 2 → 1，R 1 → 0.5；OW 从 AU22 3 改为 AU18 2 + AU22 1（实测 OW 的唇开度小于央元音，朗读时是收拢而不是外翻的唇）。没有做到的：实测 W 的唇开度很小（约 2.6 mm）而下颌并不高，模型里 W 的唇间隙偏大。测试核对了两个次序：模型的唇间隙与实测唇开度的秩相关，以及圆唇组比展唇组更靠前。
lips.en: Lip AU intensities are not calibrated and remain assumptions: the coils sit outside the vermilion border and lipApertureMm is relative to the coil distance at closure, which differs from the inner lip gap by an unknown amount (and by a factor of two between speakers); lip protrusion spans only ±1.5 mm, so only its order is trusted. A few adjustments suggested by the order were made (normal style, still assumptions): AU25 of EH 3 → 4 (EH has the largest measured lip aperture), IY 2.5 → 3, AA 3 → 2.5, L 2 → 1.5, TH 2 → 1, R 1 → 0.5; OW goes from AU22 3 to AU18 2 + AU22 1 (the measured aperture of OW is below that of schwa: pursed rather than everted lips in read speech). Not achieved: the measured lip aperture of W is very small (about 2.6 mm) although the jaw is not high, and the lip gap of W in the model is too large. Tests check two orders: the rank correlation of the model lip gap with the measured aperture, and that the rounded group lies further forward than the spread group.

tongue.zh: 舌的权重：每位说话人、每个线圈，取 (该视位的高度 − 唇音 PBM、FV 的平均高度) / (最高的视位 − 同一基准)，负值记 0，再对三位说话人平均，四舍五入到 0.05（≤ 0.1 记 0）。tip ← 舌尖线圈的高度，front ← 舌面线圈，back ← 舌背线圈，low ← 舌面线圈低于基准的程度，retro ← 舌尖线圈后缩的程度。只在没有接触约束的地方采用（各视位 provenance.tongue.measured 列出三位说话人的数）；齿龈音、边音的舌尖接触（tip = 1）是假设，因为线圈贴在舌尖后约 1 cm，取的又是音段中间三分之一的平均，看不到接触。仍然是示意的：每个姿势的位移场形状和幅度、舌的前后位置（只有 R 的后缩）、舌的侧缘、和腭的接触；高度是在上颌坐标系里量的，含下颌的贡献。
tongue.en: Tongue weights: per speaker and coil, (height in that viseme − mean height in the labials PBM and FV) / (the highest viseme − the same anchor), negatives set to 0, then averaged over the three speakers and rounded to 0.05 (0 at ≤ 0.1). tip ← height of the tip coil, front ← body coil, back ← dorsum coil, low ← how far the body coil is below the anchor, retro ← how far back the tip coil is. Adopted only where no contact constraint applies (each viseme's provenance.tongue.measured lists the three speakers' numbers); the tip contact of alveolars and the lateral (tip = 1) is an assumption, because the coil sits about 1 cm behind the tip and the mean of a segment's middle third does not show contact. Still schematic: the shape and excursion of each pose's displacement field, the front-back position of the tongue (only the retraction for R), the sides of the tongue and contact with the palate; heights are measured in the frame of the upper jaw and include the jaw's contribution.

note.zh: 120 ms 和 150 ms 取自 JALI 第 4.2 节（已读）。shortSeconds 是“短于一帧”的一帧：原文没有说帧率，这里取 1/24 秒，是假设。
note.en: The 120 ms and 150 ms are from section 4.2 of JALI (read). shortSeconds is the one frame of "shorter than one frame": the paper does not state a frame rate in what was read, and 1/24 s is assumed here.

note.zh: 假设：由原始声学特征驱动时的参数。open = 1 对应下颌张开 openJaw × jaw.max；round > 0 混入 roundViseme 的唇形，< 0 混入 spreadViseme 的；closure ≥ closureThreshold 视为“有闭合、部位不明”，做成一般的双唇闭合；每个特征的幅度乘以 min(1, 置信度 / confidenceRef)；时间常数 smoothSeconds 的一阶平滑；level 低于 levelFloor 时回到静止。dental 特征不可靠，不使用。
note.en: Assumptions: parameters of the raw-feature route. open = 1 maps to a jaw opening of openJaw × jaw.max; round > 0 blends in the lip shape of roundViseme and < 0 that of spreadViseme; closure ≥ closureThreshold counts as "a closure of unknown place" and becomes a generic lip closure; every feature's amplitude is multiplied by min(1, confidence / confidenceRef); a one-pole smoothing with time constant smoothSeconds; below levelFloor the mouth returns to rest. The dental feature is unreliable and is not used.

note.en: The source writes this sound /x/ ([h] ~ [x]), varying between the h of English hat and the ch of Scottish loch; here it is a variant of KG with reduced closure: tongue only, not classed as an obstruent, all numbers assumptions.
